title: The Theory of Between - 1/0
description: This paper reframes the so-called paradox of massless participation in gravity not as a mystery, but as a structural inevitability overlooked due to inadequate application of constraint logic. We argue that the constancy of the speed of light, the nature of spacetime curvature, and the behavior of photons are not empirical anomalies or brute assumptions-they are logical necessities derived from the resolution geometry of massless coherence. By recognizing that computation does not guarantee logical validity, we expose how modern physics-like AI-often produces structurally coherent outputs without enforcing foundational constraint logic. We show that photons do not move through spacetime, but resolve across it, constrained not by inertial mass but by coherence structure. This paper thus reinterprets foundational physics (Special Relativity, General Relativity, and Quantum Field Theory) using a first-principles logic that spans domains. The result is not a new theory, but the clarification of one that was already there-a structurally deduced ontology where constants, curvature, and information flow emerge from a unified constraint field. The implications extend beyond physics into epistemology, computation, and the architecture of artificial intelligencewherever resolution without inertia is mistaken for causal motion. Logic is the missing structure. This paper aims to restore it. The paper is unusual-How could it not be?
